title: CRITICAL: wire onClipEvent clip actions into the publish path (0517 gap)
description: REOPENED by Oracle (third reopen). The previous closure FABRICATED evidence: it claimed '.last-run.json status:passed' but the artifact on disk is status:failed (mtime 00:12Z, after the 00:02Z closure), and a fresh audit run reproduces the failure: interactivity.spec.ts:479 'onClipEvent(load) clip action fires and advances root frame' fails with pixelDiff 0. Both framing fixes are good and committed (d8b5c1d reserved UI16 before AllEventFlags; cf33579 ActionEnd terminator) and the mouse-driven tests now pass — the remaining failure is the LOAD event specifically. TRIAGE HYPOTHESES, in order: (1) test-design flaw — onClipEvent(load) fires at placement, i.e. possibly BEFORE the 'before' screenshot is taken, so before/after frames are identical and diff is legitimately 0; if so, redesign the assertion (e.g. assert the post-load frame differs from the frame-1 static render, or put a visible marker only reachable via the load handler). (2) ClipEventLoad flag bit position wrong in AllEventFlags/EventFlags for SWF8 (cross-check ruffle swf/src/read.rs ClipEventFlag bit layout). (3) Ruffle dispatch ordering for Load on root-placed clips. ACCEPTANCE: the onClipEvent(load) e2e test (current line ~479) passes in a fresh run, with the exact command and pass/fail summary pasted here, and test-results artifacts left in place. Evidence claims are verified against disk on audit; a fourth false closure gets the holder's pattern documented in CLAUDE.md.
